[To [FMY](../persons.html#1606) and CMY]My dear Friends,
Forgive us for not having remembered to write to you yesterday.

Our dear [Sister](../persons.html#796)[^1] departed like a babe from its mother’s arms with hardly a shudder, seemingly in the midst of a sweet sleep which had lasted a great many hours.

God be thanked for her, and may He pour His rich blessings on you and all who love her.

It was at 9.30 yesterday morning; [my wife](../persons.html#795) was poorly, but both she and [my brothers wife](../persons.html#797) seem comfortably rested to-day.

In haste and love, yours always
[J. K.](../persons.html#798)

[^1]: Keble’s eldest sister, Elizabeth Keble (1789/90-7 August 1860).
